hypotheses.R0_fisher_axes_have_privileged_frozen_gr: Residual-Fisher axes exceed matched-random p95 frozen top-64 held-out gradient-energy capture by at least 0.02 at every layer.
hypotheses.R1_fisher_axes_have_privileged_frozen_co: Residual-Fisher axes exceed matched-random p95 frozen top-64 held-out contribution-mass capture by at least 0.02 at every layer.
hypotheses.R2_frozen_support_approaches_endpoint_or: Frozen residual-Fisher top-64 supports retain at least half of endpoint-oracle top-64 gradient and contribution capture at every layer.
hypotheses.R3_same_axis_support_recurs: Same-axis endpoint supports exceed different-axis supports by at least 0.02 median Jaccard at every layer.
hypotheses.R4_leading_axes_are_more_reusable: The leading four Fisher axes exceed the trailing twelve by at least 0.02 frozen gradient capture at every layer.
